about: Two lab runs (docs/research/raw-footage.md, section 2) written as whisper.cpp 1.8.2 writes -ojf with -ml 1 -sow: the words and probabilities are faster-whisper small's, the layout, token splits, special tokens and closed segment edges are whisper.cpp's. 'swallowed' is a whole-file run that merged one take into a stretched word and dropped another; 'isolated' is every voiced stretch transcribed alone. 'envelope' is the session's loudness, dBFS per 10 ms.
